# package knxnetip

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-knx/knxnetip"
```

Package knxnetip encodes and decodes KNXnet/IP frames: the header, host protocol address information (HPAI), description information blocks (DIB), connection request and response information (CRI, CRD) and the bodies of the core, device management, tunnelling, routing and secure services.

Decoding is strict and never panics: every length field is checked against the data, structures of a fixed size must have that size, and a frame of an unknown service type decodes to [Unknown](#type-unknown) with its body kept. Encoding is deterministic: a decoded frame encodes back to the same octets.

The cEMI frames that tunnelling, routing and device management carry are kept as octets here; package cemi decodes them.

## Constants

```go
const (
	// HeaderLen is the length of the KNXnet/IP header.
	HeaderLen = 6
	// Version10 is the KNXnet/IP protocol version 1.0 of the header.
	Version10 = 0x10
	// Port is the KNXnet/IP UDP and TCP port.
	Port = 3671
	// MaxFrameLen bounds the frames this package decodes and encodes.
	// The total length field has 16 bits; UDP datagrams of KNXnet/IP are
	// far shorter (a cEMI frame carries at most 255 octets of NPDU).
	MaxFrameLen = 1024
)
```

Protocol constants.

```go
const DeviceInfoLen = 54
```

DeviceInfoLen is the length of a DEVICE\_INFO DIB.

```go
const HPAILen = 8
```

HPAILen is the length of an IPv4 HPAI.

```go
const MACLen = 16
```

MACLen is the length of the CCM message authentication code of KNX IP Secure.

## Variables

```go
var MulticastAddress = netip.AddrFrom4([4]byte{224, 0, 23, 12})
```

MulticastAddress is the KNXnet/IP system setup multicast address used by discovery and, by default, routing.

## Functions

### func Append

```go
func Append(b []byte, m Message) ([]byte, error)
```

Append appends the frame of m, header included.

### func AppendHeader

```go
func AppendHeader(b []byte, service ServiceType, bodyLen int) []byte
```

AppendHeader appends a header for service with a body of bodyLen octets. A total length that does not fit the 16-bit length field (bodyLen \< 0 or bodyLen+\[HeaderLen] > 65535) is written as 0, which [ParseHeader](#func-parseheader) rejects, rather than wrapped to a length that would frame a different datagram.

### func Marshal

```go
func Marshal(m Message) ([]byte, error)
```

Marshal returns the frame of m, header included.

### func ReadFrame

```go
func ReadFrame(r io.Reader) ([]byte, error)
```

ReadFrame reads one frame from a stream (KNXnet/IP over TCP): the header, then the body its total length announces. Frames longer than MaxFrameLen are refused before their body is read.

### type HPAI

```go
type HPAI struct {
	Protocol HostProtocol
	Addr     netip.AddrPort
```

HPAI is a host protocol address information structure: an IPv4 endpoint and its protocol. The unspecified endpoint 0.0.0.0:0 ("route back", or NAT mode) asks the peer to answer to the source of the datagram.

Session status codes.

### type Status

```go
type Status uint8
```

Status is a KNXnet/IP status (error) code of a response or acknowledgement.

```go
const (
	StatusNoError             Status = 0x00 // E_NO_ERROR
	StatusHostProtocolType    Status = 0x01 // E_HOST_PROTOCOL_TYPE
	StatusVersionNotSupported Status = 0x02 // E_VERSION_NOT_SUPPORTED
	StatusSequenceNumber      Status = 0x04 // E_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
	StatusGenericError        Status = 0x0F // E_ERROR (tunnelling feature services)
	StatusConnectionID        Status = 0x21 // E_CONNECTION_ID
	StatusConnectionType      Status = 0x22 // E_CONNECTION_TYPE
	StatusConnectionOption    Status = 0x23 // E_CONNECTION_OPTION
	StatusNoMoreConnections   Status = 0x24 // E_NO_MORE_CONNECTIONS
	StatusNoMoreUniqueConns   Status = 0x25 // E_NO_MORE_UNIQUE_CONNECTIONS
	StatusDataConnection      Status = 0x26 // E_DATA_CONNECTION
	StatusKNXConnection       Status = 0x27 // E_KNX_CONNECTION
	StatusAuthorisationError  Status = 0x28 // E_AUTHORISATION_ERROR (tunnelling v2)
	StatusTunnellingLayer     Status = 0x29 // E_TUNNELLING_LAYER
	StatusNoTunnellingAddress Status = 0x2D // E_NO_TUNNELLING_ADDRESS (tunnelling v2)
	StatusConnectionInUse     Status = 0x2E // E_CONNECTION_IN_USE (tunnelling v2)
)
```

Status codes.

#### func StatusOf

```go
func StatusOf(err error) (Status, bool)
```

StatusOf returns the status of a \*StatusError in err's chain.

#### func (Status) String

```go
func (s Status) String() string
```

String returns the name of the status code, such as "E\_NO\_MORE\_CONNECTIONS", or "0x%02X" for an unknown one.

### type StatusError

```go
type StatusError struct {
	Service ServiceType
	Status  Status
}
```

StatusError is a response or acknowledgement with a status other than E\_NO\_ERROR. It matches [knx.ErrRejected](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-knx#ErrRejected) with errors.Is, and [knx.ErrBusy](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-knx#ErrBusy) for E\_NO\_MORE\_CONNECTIONS and E\_NO\_MORE\_UNIQUE\_CONNECTIONS.

#### func (StatusError) Error

```go
func (e *StatusError) Error() string
```

Error describes the failure, for example "knxnetip: CONNECT\_RESPONSE: E\_NO\_MORE\_CONNECTIONS (0x24)".

#### func (StatusError) Is

```go
func (e *StatusError) Is(target error) bool
```

Is matches knx.ErrRejected and, for exhausted connections, knx.ErrBusy.
